2608.05204.title: SkillTrace: Multi-Trace Provenance Auditing for LLM-Agent Skill Reuse
2608.05204.paper_summary: LLM-agent ecosystems are rapidly growing around reusable skills: mixed-modality packages of metadata, natural-language instructions, code, tools, references, and operational workflows. As skills become marketplace artifacts, auditing their reuse is no longer the same problem as ordinary code clone detection. Existing detectors target single-modality source code or whole-package similarity, yet skill reuse evidence is distributed across authored text, implementation fragments, and operational structure. As a result, they can miss reuse that preserves only one part of a skill. We present SKILLTRACE, a multi-trace provenance auditing framework for LLM-agent skill reuse. SKILLTRACE extracts three provenance traces: Expression, Implementation, and Operational. It represents the Operational Trace as a Skill Operational Graph (SOG) that captures activation, procedure, and resource-flow structure. An LLM assists only the Operational-trace extraction, once at ingestion; at audit time SKILLTRACE compares cached traces deterministically, calibrates each trace against same-function strict negatives, and reports which trace supports a reuse decision. On SKILLTRACE-BENCH, with 820 transformed reuse positives over 100 marketplace anchors and 751 negative controls, SKILLTRACE achieves AUROC 0.938 and F1 0.898. A 36,446-skill wild audit further shows that trace-attributed evidence surfaces actionable reuse review queues beyond repository-level baselines.
2608.05204.paper_summary_zh: LLM-agent 生態系統正在迅速發展，圍繞可重用技能：混合模態的元數據包、自然語言指令、代碼、工具、參考資料和操作工作流程。隨著技能成為市場工件，審計其重用不再是普通代碼克隆檢測的相同問題。現有的檢測器針對單一模態的源代碼或整個包的相似性，但技能重用的證據分散在作者文本、實現片段和操作結構中。因此，它們可能會錯過僅保留技能一部分的重用。我們提出了 SKILLTRACE，一個用於 LLM-agent 技能重用的多追蹤來源審計框架。SKILLTRACE 提取三個來源追蹤：表達、實現和操作。它將操作追蹤表示為技能操作圖（SOG），捕捉激活、程序和資源流動結構。LLM 僅在攝取時協助操作追蹤的提取；在審計時，SKILLTRACE 確定性地比較緩存的追蹤，根據相同功能的嚴格負例校準每個追蹤，並報告哪個追蹤支持重用決策。在 SKILLTRACE-BENCH 上，對 100 個市場錨點的 820 個轉換重用正例和 751 個負控制，SKILLTRACE 實現了 AUROC 0.938 和 F1 0.898。一項 36,446 技能的野外審計進一步顯示，追蹤所屬的證據顯示出可行的重用審查隊列，超越了庫級基準。
